CanvasHistoryRecord [canvasHistory.ts]
  canvasViews [canvasView.ts]
    saved[viewId]: CanvasView
      startCheckpointId   comparison baseline
      checkpointIds[]     ordered view checkpoints
      finalCheckpointId   latest saved endpoint
      parentViewId        ancestor in the view tree
      forkCheckpointId    pinned branch source
      alternativeGroupId  sibling candidate set
    activeViewId          current editor identity
    workingCopies[viewId] unsaved checkpoint per view
    recording?            legacy capture in progress
  snapshots[id]: StoredCanvasSnapshot
    document + diagramBindings + personal view
  headId / past / future  live canvas and undo navigation
  diagramRevisions[id]    versions used by snapshots
